about: Follow-ups of the blind-spot check (2026-11-17), behind the PvP results report (https://claude.ai/artifact/3bymgBoUqniRf3HN2MgcJ5, private): improved = the confirmed gains combined (seeds 3 and 4, 240 a matchup); battleground = the duel build with the talents duels undervalue put back one at a time while within a point of it (seed 3, 240); repay = a second payment for rated rows; pets = each pet class's winner with its pet lost at 0 s or 15 s (seed 3, 120); ice_block_rule = the mage's block rule against healers (3 variants); ice_block_pay = Ice Block on the Frost and Arcane winners paid from each talent; holy_gear = Holy Shock with the paladin's gear row held (melee) or swapped (caster); matrices = the field (community builds) and each class's best build against each other (200 a matchup, seed 1). Made by one-off scripts in the session's scratchpad; pvp-plan.md's log of 2026-11-17 describes each.
